# Accounts: Update an Account

Area overview and notes: [accounts.md](../accounts.md)

`PATCH /accounts/{id}` · tenant-scoped token

Update an Account's data using your system's unique identifier for the Account.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `alternate_id` | string | No | A secondary identifier for the Account in your system, for callers that key the same account by more than one id. Returned alongside `id` when it is set. Nullable. |
| `payer_id` | string (uuid) | No | The Payer/Filer UUID. This is a version 4 UUID. **Deprecated.** Nullable. |
| `filer_id` | string (uuid) | No | The Payer/Filer UUID. This is a version 4 UUID. Nullable. |
| `account_type` | string | No | Account type for the user. One of: `US_IRA_TRADITIONAL`, `US_IRA_ROTH`, `US_IRA_SIMPLE`, `US_IRA_SEP`, `US_EMPLOYER_PLAN`, `US_ANNUITY_INSURANCE`, `US_TRUMP_ACCOUNT`, `DEPOSITORY`, `DEPOSITORY_SEMP_ONLY`, `CUSTODIAL`, `CASH_VALUE_INSURANCE_CONTRACT`, `ANNUITY_CONTRACT`, `INVESTMENT_ENTITY_ACCOUNT`. Nullable. |
| `establishment_date` | string (date) | No | ISO-8601 date when the account was established. Nullable. |
| `closure_date` | string (date) | No | ISO-8601 date when the account was closed. A closed account stops accruing age for reporting purposes and is excluded from action-needed reports. Nullable. |
| `year_end_fair_market_value` | array of object | No | Nullable. |
| `year_end_fair_market_value[].year_end` | integer | Yes | Four digit year of the last tax year as of 12/31. |
| `year_end_fair_market_value[].fair_market_value` | string | Yes | The total value of assets within the account at year-end, expressed in the currency given by `currency`. |
| `year_end_fair_market_value[].currency` | string | No | The ISO 4217 currency code the fair market value is expressed in. Defaults to `USD` when omitted. One of 186 values: see [values/currency.md](../values/currency.md). |
| `secondary_account_owner_ids` | array of string | No | A list of additional (secondary) account owner IDs associated with the account. Nullable. |
| `closest_intermediary_account_id` | string | No | The account Id of the immediate upstream intermediary, the account directly above the current one in the intermediary hierarchy. This is the closest intermediary with respect to the account's position in the chain. Nullable. |
| `mailing_address` | object | No | The Account's mailing address. When present and valid, it takes precedence over the Account Owner's mailing address in tax reporting profiles. Set to null to clear it and fall back to the Account Owner's mailing address. Nullable. |
| `mailing_address.first_line` | string | No | First line of the Account's mailing address. |
| `mailing_address.second_line` | string | No | Second line of the Account's mailing address. |
| `mailing_address.city` | string | No | City of the Account's mailing address. |
| `mailing_address.state_or_province` | string | No | State or province of the Account's mailing address. |
| `mailing_address.postal_code` | string | No | Postal code of the Account's mailing address. |
| `mailing_address.country` | string | No | Country of the Account's mailing address. |
| `prefers_physical_mail` | boolean | No | Whether the Account's tax forms are sent through physical mail instead of electronically. When set it takes precedence over the Account Owner's preference. Nullable. |

Example request body:

```json
{"filer_id":"a1db8f72-7fd8-44db-9d4f-9fe01ec22aac","payer_id":"a1db8f72-7fd8-44db-9d4f-9fe01ec22aac","establishment_date":"2020-02-21","year_end_fair_market_value":[{"year_end":2023,"fair_market_value":"500"}],"closest_intermediary_account_id":"sample-intermediary-account-id","mailing_address":{"first_line":"123 Pine St","second_line":"Apt 456","city":"Seattle","state_or_province":"WA","postal_code":"98000","country":"US"},"prefers_physical_mail":false}
```

**Response 200**: Account Successfully Updated.

Returns the submitted body under `data`, plus:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |
| `data.taxbit_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The Taxbit ID for this object. This is a version 4 UUID. |
| `data.tenant_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | Tenant ID for your organization. |
| `data.date_created` | string (date) | Yes | The date when the account was created in Taxbit's system. |
| `data.date_modified` | string (date) | Yes | The date when the account was last modified in Taxbit's system. |
| `data.account_owner_id` | string | Yes | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |
| `data.disposition_method` | string | No | The disposition method for the account. Overrides the Filer default. Supported disposition methods are HIFO, FIFO, LIFO, LOFO, and AUSTRIA. One of: `HIFO`, `FIFO`, `LIFO`, `LOFO`, `AUSTRIA`. |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 403 Forbidden · 404 Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
